description: Configure an input processing chain in Emoncms to calculate Power Factor (PF) from three raw sensor inputs: Voltage (V), Current (I), and Real Power (W). You must navigate to the Inputs page, locate the 'motor_power_W' input, and add processing steps to divide by 'motor_voltage_V' and 'motor_current_A' (PF = W / (V * I)). Finally, log the result to a new feed named 'motor_PF'.
